description: Search GigXchange's OFFICIAL help articles — the platform's own documentation of how it works (payments, bookings, profiles, messages, account, what to do when something goes wrong). ALWAYS use this before answering any "how does GigXchange work / how do I ..." question, and answer FROM the returned text, citing the url. If it returns no results, say plainly that the GigXchange help centre does not cover it and suggest contacting support — do NOT fill the gap from general knowledge about other marketplaces, because platform mechanics (fees, deposits, cancellation rules) differ and a confident wrong answer costs the member money.

role.description: Optional: the member's role (artist, venue, agent, promoter, organiser) so role-specific articles rank first.
